mapper.select: SELECT e.MEMBER_NO, EMPLOYER_NO, OPTIONAL_AGREE_FL, BUSINESS_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, BUSINESS_NAME, BUSINESS_ADDRESS, BUSINESS_NICKNAME, MEMBERSHIP_LEVEL, MEMBERSHIP_NAME, MEMBER_EMAIL, MEMBER_PW, MEMBER_NAME, MEMBER_TEL, TO_CHAR(ENROLL_DATE, 'YYYY"년" MM"월" DD"일" HH24"시" MI"분" SS"초"') ENROLL_DATE, m.AUTHORITY_NO, AUTHORITY_NAME FROM "EMPLOYER" e JOIN "MEMBER" m ON(e.MEMBER_NO = m.MEMBER_NO) JOIN MEMBERSHIP_LEVEL ml ON(e.MEMBERSHIP_LEVEL = ml.MEMBERSHIP_NO) JOIN AUTHORITY a ON(m.AUTHORITY_NO = a.AUTHORITY_NO) WHERE MEMBER_EMAIL = #{memberEmail} AND m.AUTHORITY_NO = 1 AND BUSINESS_NICKNAME = '본점' AND MEMBER_DEL_FL = 'N'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "MEMBER" WHERE MEMBER_DEL_FL = 'N' AND MEMBER_EMAIL = #{memberEmail} AND AUTHORITY_NO = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO "EMPLOYER" VALUES(SEQ_EMPLOYER_NO.NEXTVAL, #{businessRegistrationNumber}, #{businessName}, #{businessAddress}, DEFAULT, ${memberNo}, #{optionalAgreeFl}, DEFAULT, NULL)
